# ATLAS - complete, verifiable dependency closure.
#
# Generated by `pip freeze` inside a freshly created virtual environment that
# installed exactly `requirements.txt` + `requirements-dev.txt`:
#
#   python -m venv .venv
#   .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt
#   .venv/bin/python -m pip freeze
#
# This is evidence of installability, not a transcription: every version below
# was resolved and installed together on CPython 3.13.
#
# Deliberate properties:
#   * No package-index URLs. Install through whichever mirror the environment
#     uses; resolved integrity hashes are unaffected.
#   * No Windows-only packages, so the file installs unchanged in the Linux
#     container image built from the Dockerfile.
#   * Heavyweight AI backends are intentionally absent. They are pinned in
#     requirements-optional.txt and every one of them has a zero-dependency
#     fallback, so the clean-room chain stays small and fast.
#
# Verify with:  python scripts/verify.py
